english.note: Use this as the everyday choice for a paper napkin at a meal, although it can also mean a general tissue.
This is the all-purpose choice for a sheet of paper tissue, including a facial tissue or handkerchief tissue.

examples.english: After eating, grab a napkin and wipe your mouth.
examples.traditional: 食完嘢攞張紙巾抹下嘴啦。
